description: The plot illustrates an ablation study on the HateXplain dataset, representing the performance of different model variants across various metrics. The x-axis is labeled "Model Variants" and displays categorical values: "Full model (Ours)", "w/o Prompt", "w/o Augmentation", "w/o Attention", and "w/o Prompt & Augmentation". The y-axis is labeled "Metric (%)" and uses a linear scale ranging from 58 to 66, with tick marks at intervals of 2. The plot contains three solid lines with circular markers. The purple line, whose legend label is obscured by a grey box, starts at 65.45 for the "Full model (Ours)", declines to 61.06 at "w/o Prompt", and then steadily increases through 62.22 at "w/o Augmentation" and 64.06 at "w/o Attention", ending at 65.44 for "w/o Prompt & Augmentation". The light blue line, labeled "Recall", begins at 65.78 for the "Full model (Ours)", drops to 59.64 at "w/o Prompt", rises to 63.75 at "w/o Augmentation", decreases to 59.17 at "w/o Attention", and ends at 56.82 for "w/o Prompt & Augmentation". The tan line, labeled "F1-score", starts at 65.56 for the "Full model (Ours)", decreases to 60.16 at "w/o Prompt", increases to 62.63 at "w/o Augmentation", drops to 59.67 at "w/o Attention", and concludes at 57.74 for "w/o Prompt & Augmentation".
